facts.evidence: Net revenue for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026, was $11.6 billion, an increase of 14% year-over-year and a 13% increase on a constant-dollar basis.

GAAP net income for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026, was $5.6 billion, or $2.97 per share, representing a 7% increase in net income and a 10% increase in earnings per share over the prior year.

Non-GAAP net income for the fiscal third quarter ended June 3 and 2026 was $6.3 billion, or $3.32 per share, representing an 8% increase in net income and an 11% increase in earnings per share over the prior year. [Note: 'June 3 and 2026' is a garbled rendering of June 30, 2026; the period label 'fiscal third quarter', the basis and all figures are correct.]

Data processing revenue rose 17% over the prior year to $6.0 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026. [Note: figure, growth rate, period and basis all correct; the brief does not note that it is the largest revenue category.]

GAAP operating expenses for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026, were $4.8 billion, a 19% increase over the prior year. ... Track the trend in personnel expenses, as GAAP operating expenses increased 19% year-over-year, primarily driven by an increase in personnel expenses. [Note: the brief does not explicitly observe that 19% opex growth outpaced 14% revenue growth, though both figures appear.]

Payments volume for the three months ended June 30, 2026, increased 10% over the prior year on a constant-dollar basis. ... Total cross-border volume on a constant-dollar basis increased 13% over the prior year for the three months ended June 30, 2026. [Payments volume +10% constant dollar is correct, but the brief substitutes total cross-border volume (+13%) for cross-border volume excluding intra-Europe (+12%); the ex-intra-Europe measure the release ties to international transaction revenue is never given.]
Cash, cash equivalents and investment securities were $13.9 billion at June 30, 2026.

Monitor the impact of special items on profitability, including $563 million for severance costs and $237 million for a litigation provision associated with the interchange multidistrict litigation ("MDL") case recorded in the current fiscal third quarter.

claims.claim: Non-GAAP earnings per share for the fiscal third quarter were $3.32.
Non-GAAP net income increased 8% over the prior year.
Non-GAAP earnings per share increased 11% over the prior year.
Net revenue for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026 was $11.6 billion, an increase of 14% year-over-year.
Net revenue increased 13% on a constant-dollar basis.
GAAP operating expenses for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026 were $4.8 billion.
GAAP operating expenses were a 19% increase over the prior year.
Payments volume for the three months ended June 30, 2026 increased 10% over the prior year on a constant-dollar basis.
Total cross-border volume on a constant-dollar basis increased 13% over the prior year for the three months ended June 30, 2026.
Processed transactions for the three months ended June 30, 2026 were 71.7 billion, a 10% increase over the prior year.
Data processing revenue rose 17% over the prior year to $6.0 billion for the fiscal third quarter ended June 30, 2026.
The release provides no guidance or outlook.

During the three months ended June 30, 2026, Visa repurchased approximately 14.5 million shares of class A common stock for $4.9 billion.
The board of directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.670 per share of class A common stock, payable on September 1, 2026.
Special items recorded in the current fiscal third quarter included $563 million for severance costs.
Special items recorded in the current fiscal third quarter included $237 million for a litigation provision associated with the interchange multidistrict litigation (MDL) case.
The 19% year-over-year increase in GAAP operating expenses was primarily driven by an increase in personnel expenses.
Remaining authorized funds for share repurchases stood at $28.4 billion as of June 30, 2026.
